content.comment_body: Hello, The [product_name] with article number [article_no] has been discontinued, and there is no direct successor listed. Could you recommend a suitable [product_name] to replace [article_no]? The description is: [product_name] logic module, display, power: 24V/24V/relay plus clock, 12 inputs/8 outputs, memory for 56 blocks, DIN rail mounting standard. Can you clarify what RCL stands for?

The [product_name] with article number [article_no] (24RCL) operated at 24VDC in the long version, featuring 12 digital inputs and 8 digital outputs. For replacement, you can use the current [product_name] (12/24VDC) along with a suitable digital expansion module such as [product_name] expansion 8 or 16 digital outputs. For the latest firmware version [version_no], the current software required is [product_name] V8.1, article number [article_no].
R stands for relay, C is for clock, and L means long version. The long version provides 12 digital inputs and 8 outputs, while the standard version offers 8 digital inputs and 4 outputs.
